name: Ferienhaus Alpenrose
beschreibung:
Situated in a quiet area of Serfaus, Ferienhaus Alpenrose welcomes guests with a warm, relaxing atmosphere. The tastefully furnished apartments feature fully equipped kitchens and sunny balconies with splendid views of the Tyrolean Alps.

Mountain cable cars and the village underground are within easy reach, offering rapid access to the extensive skiing, hiking, and family activities of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhaus Alpenrose in Serfaus provides comfortable holiday apartments on the sunny high plateau for active travellers and families.
